written when the lock changes, by its writer; refused unless every mount hashes to the lock; pruned to the newest 20 lock refs plus main and every open PR's lock

notes
Supersedes lpc-cat-mount and the other cat-mount Actions caches. Untrusted but exactly verified, so a stale or tampered ref only costs time. Measured on folio-assistant's lock (12 layers, ~32k files): 69 s per repository against 27 s on a hit with every byte verified. Every target needs it (it is the root of every needs closure), so it carries no `materializes`.
